notes.title: Patch 1.31
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelong[/h1]
-Fixed more typos
-Due to several false typo reports, changed script of every case to use American spelling for words instead of Canadian.
-Made it so that achievements for Case completion will be retroactively unlocked for any cases that the player completed before Patch 1.30

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed bug where Save/Load Menu could be opened during ARGUMENTS and other sections where saving is disabled.
-Fixed bug where Lucio Steelwind's hands would be rendered during the incorrect animation.
-Fixed bug where Ruby Tymora's hands would sometimes render behind the desk during her TABLE SLAM animation.

notes.title: Patch 1.29

-Circumvented Unity issue that would cause ALT key to be falsely read as "pressed" after ALT-tabbing.

notes.title: Patch 1.26

-Fixed issue where progressing through text at "Instant" text speed could cause the ProgressCallback to be called twice in one frame.

notes.title: Patch 1.25

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 1.22
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
-Fixed more typos
-Adjusted minor plot inconsistencies
-Removed some Table Slams that were awkwardly close to each other.
-Added controller support. Current implementation has only been tested with PS4 controllers. Will be closely monitoring this build for any bug reports.
-Implemented rebindable inputs for both keyboard and controllers.
-Updated background art of certain locations.
-Added "Instant" text speed option. This option instantly displays each dialogue instead of typing them out.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed bug in Case 5 where the Back Alley location could still be travelled to after unlocking the Den. Attempting to EXAMINE this area would result in a soft lock.
-Fixed bug where progressing through dialogue extremely rapidly would throw a NullReferenceException.
-Fixed bug with facial animations of Celeste (her red dress sprites) in Case 4.

Cycling through the failure state once during this section will automatically add this to the inventory if it isn't already there. (For those with save files at this section).

notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
-Fixed several typos present throughout the game.
-Thoughts seen through the Eye of Horus are now present in the Text Log
-"OBJECTION!" messages are now present in the Text Log
-The colour hue for most spells has been changed to match their school of magic
-Icon for Celeste's Sword now matches its appearance in the CGs and location art.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
-Save files created during the "Evidence Obtained" message used to be corrupted. This would throw an Exception whenever the Save File is loaded. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Attorney of the Arcane Indiegogo Campaign. Launching on August 15!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0jGcCkaFNzw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi, everyone! It's been a long road to getting this ready but I'm proud to announce that I'll be launching a crowdfunding campaign for Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane on August 15! Look forward to seeing it on indiegogo.

Be sure to check out our [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/attorney-of-the-arcane-courtroom-visual-novel/coming_soon/x/15639865]PRE-LAUNCH PAGE[/url]! Spread the word and sign up in preparation for our crowdfunding launch!
